outcome: Hemoglobin values before and after birth
Obstetric outcomes (abortion, premature delivery, term birth)
finding: Performing a myomectomy during cesarean section in pregnant women with fibroids did not significantly affect hemoglobin values compared to those who did not have a myomectomy, but it did double the operating time.
mod_finding: This study reports that the majority of women with fibroids (85.96%) delivered by cesarean section.
